A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CGKE/CDKC framework. Their main text, figures, Tables 1–9, theoretical appendix, experimental appendices, and prompt templates are available and can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original QA experiments, ablations, self-knowledge assessments, calibration analyses, and evaluations across model scales and non-QA tasks.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main comparisons and the additional experiments and case studies in Appendix C.

M1.justification: CGKE region assignment, retrieval-based augmentation and supervised training, and CDKC entropy regularization within GRPO remain unchanged. The prompt templates and iterative expansion-calibration procedure are also retained.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 11 QA benchmarks, answerable/unanswerable self-knowledge task, and gsm8k, T-REx, WoW, and FEVER evaluations. Training remains based on NQ, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMQA.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the corresponding experiments. Figure 4 corrects 'CRew-GRPO' to 'CRew-DPO', matching Table 4 in both versions; this is a label correction, not a different baseline.

E3.justification: Model configurations, data counts, training budgets, and evaluation metrics are unchanged. The ECE protocol with 10 equal-mass bins and confidence exp(-NLL) moves from Appendix C.5 to Section 5.4. Both regularization coefficients remain 0.001.

E4.justification: The component ablations, scaling analysis, calibration analyses, sample-level partitioning, and case studies are retained. The new ECE heatmap redisplays the existing Appendix C.5 analysis rather than introducing another experiment or robustness test.

E5.justification: Both versions retain K=16 sampled reasoning paths and the same mean-and-standard-deviation reporting in the decay plots. No new repeated-training counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests are reported.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 retain their numerical results and case-study outputs, and the matched plots retain their outcomes. For example, two-round CDKC's average ECE remains 24.34 versus 60.41 for Vanilla LLM. The heatmap and newly stated reduction exceeding 59% re-express existing results.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, structural decay relationship, and Appendix A propositions and derivations are unchanged. The ECE equation is relocated and renumbered; the additional Appendix A citation does not alter its reasoning.

C1.justification: The central claims about targeted knowledge expansion, confidence calibration, and clearer knowledge boundaries remain unchanged. The revised conclusion foregrounds the already-reported decay relationship and bidirectional entropy mechanism rather than introducing a new contribution.

C2.justification: New Section 5.4 interprets calibration differences across grounding states through knowledge internalization and boundary sensitivity. Section 5.5 expands the architecture-specific interpretation of overconfidence and underconfidence, while Section 5.1 more explicitly emphasizes inference efficiency.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-repository link in the abstract and explains the rationale for setting both regularization coefficients to 0.001. The coefficient values, hardware, data-processing details, and prompts were already documented in v1.

R1.justification: v2 adds Chen et al. (2024), three Fan et al. works, and Huang et al. (2026), and removes Fellaji et al. (2024). These are limited citation changes; the positioning relative to existing meta-cognition and knowledge-augmentation approaches remains substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 locally revises explanatory prose and the conclusion, adds acknowledgments, and moves the ECE explanation into a dedicated main-text subsection. The structural-decay discussion becomes Section 5.5, while the broader organization remains intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds the Figure 5 ECE heatmap, restyles existing decay plots, revises captions and legends, and corrects labels including 'KDKC' to 'CDKC'. Figures are redistributed and renumbered, while table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The main-text ECE section and heatmap make previously appended calibration evidence easier to assess. Corrected figure labels and added code-access information improve clarity and reproducibility documentation. These are limited gains because the underlying method, empirical evidence, and theoretical support remain unchanged.
